answer: The haven schedule is applied in kernel and horizon reveals each instalment. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2086 identities would post 3438 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
